answer: Send an unannounced gale through the network: for one random minute, the protocol throttles a random subset of relays and records how each agent's response latency bends. Independent agents on separate machines stagger in their own ways; a hundred identities hosted on one box all stall and recover in the same rhythm, a shared hollow behind many faces. A raven-eyed clustering pass flags identities whose delay curves match too closely, and their combined reward is capped as if they were one agent.
